title: lenz.dev
tagline: lenz.dev: Own your filters, earn crypto, and build the future of AR creation

prizes.title: Best dApp built on Saga Chainlet

description: lenz.dev is a creator-first mini app built on Base that lets anyone tokenize their AR filters, spatial experiences, and mini-games as on-chain assets, turning creative work into ownable and monetizable digital property. Unlike Web2 platforms like Meta, Snap, and YouTube—where creators are gatekept, underpaid, and stripped of ownership—lenz.dev ensures every interaction with a filter or experience (uses, likes, shares, remixes, playtime) is transparently tracked on-chain and automatically tied to earnings. Creators receive weekly crypto rewards from a shared rewards pool, with payouts proportional to their community impact, while tips, licensing, and remix revenue flow directly to them via programmable splits. This makes discovery, attribution, and monetization fair, transparent, and community-driven, giving power back to creators and unlocking a new open economy for spatial creativity.
how_its_made: This project is built on Coin base's Base chain and Saga for on-chain infrastructure , with a Next.js frontend powering the web experience. All AR effects and spatial content are created in Snap Lens Studio, which integrates seamlessly into the app’s on-chain monetization and engagement system.
